nodes.name: Quill Stem Wedge
nodes.description: A bolt draws up a wedge or cone which secures the stem tightly inside the column.

function.name: Stem Retention
function.note: Bolt draws up wedge or cone to secure stem

evidence.quote:
A bolt draws up a wedge or cone which secures
the stem tightly inside the column.

nodes.name: Quill Stem Binder Bolt
nodes.description: The stem binder bolt outside of the quill should have a layer of grease or anti-seize before installing and tightening.

lubrication.name: Thread Lubrication
lubrication.note: Stem binder bolt, bolt head, wedge should have layer of grease or anti-seize

evidence.quote:
The stem binder bolt, bolt head, wedge,
and outside of the quill should have a layer of grease or anti-seize before
installing and tightening.

nodes.name: Quill Stem Vertical Post
nodes.description: The vertical post that inserts inside of a threaded steering column.

insertion.name: Insertion Location
insertion.note: Vertical post inserts inside of a threaded steering column

evidence.quote:
The “quill” of quill stem refers to the vertical post that inserts inside of a
threaded steering column.

nodes.name: Quill to Steering Column Diameter Match
nodes.description: The stem’s quill diameter is a correct match for the inside diameter of the steering column. The quill should be slightly smaller than the inside of the column.

clearance_rule.name: Diameter Match
clearance_rule.note: Quill should be slightly smaller than the inside of the column

evidence.quote:
It is important that the stem’s quill diameter is a correct match for the
inside diameter of the steering column. The quill should be slightly smaller
than the inside of the column.
